name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's culinary journey began in his grandmother's Lisbon kitchen, where he learned the secrets of authentic Portuguese cuisine. After earning a degree in hospitality management, he worked in several high-end restaurants before a chance encounter with a racing team owner sparked his interest in motorsport. Seeing the potential to elevate the paddock dining experience, Ricardo transitioned to catering, bringing his passion for quality and efficiency to the high-pressure world of racing.

At JHR Developments, Ricardo is responsible for managing all aspects of team catering, from menu planning and sourcing ingredients to meal preparation and service. He believes that a well-fed team is a high-performing team, and he strives to provide nutritious and delicious meals that fuel the drivers and crew. His innovative approach to paddock cuisine, combined with his unwavering commitment to excellence, sets him apart.
Ricardo's long-term goal is to revolutionize motorsport catering. He envisions a future where teams prioritize the well-being of their staff through exceptional culinary offerings, creating a more positive and productive environment for everyone involved.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build, with a warm smile and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down new recipe ideas.
Insists on using only fresh, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
Has a peculiar habit of humming Portuguese Fado tunes while preparing meals.
